title: When Trust Collides: Decoding Human-LLM Cooperation Dynamics through the Prisoner’s Dilemma
reasoning: The paper investigates 'moral condemnation' and 'asymmetric moral expectations' that human participants exhibit toward LLM agents during a Prisoner's Dilemma game, a classic social and moral dilemma. It explicitly measures how humans judge the 'betrayal' of AI agents compared to humans and rule-based systems.
